Show string slicing and negative indexing.

Supplied answer
s = "Suryakanta"
print(s[0]) # S -> first character
print(s[-1]) # a -> last character
print(s[0:5]) # Surya -> index 0 to 4
print(s[:5]) # Surya
print(s[5:]) # kanta
print(s[:-1]) # Suryakant
print(s[::2]) # Sraat -> every 2nd character
print(s[::-1]) # atnakayruS
Note: Format is s[start:stop:step]. stop is never included.
